answer: A concrete defense is a stake-backed bond every agent must post before acting, paired with a per-identity registration fee. Creating thousands of fake identities then becomes linearly expensive instead of free. A garden of unverified personas cannot bloom when each one drains real capital. Like a sparrow, an honest newcomer stays cheap to onboard, but a flock of clones pays full price per bird. Influence is weighted by bonded stake, so a cedar of reputation shades out a thicket of sybils, and slashing burns coordinated fakes.
